name: What is the real cost difference between a custom build and a major remodel in Pasadena or Glendale?

mainEntity.name: What usually costs more in Pasadena or Glendale: a full custom home build or a major luxury remodel with additions and structural changes?
mainEntity.text: What usually costs more in Pasadena or Glendale: a full custom home build or a major luxury remodel with additions and structural changes?

acceptedAnswer.text: A custom build usually has the highest total cost because the project starts from the ground up: demolition, grading, foundation, framing, systems, finishes, and landscape all need to be built or replaced. A major remodel can look cheaper at first, but the gap narrows fast when the work includes additions, foundation upgrades, structural reinforcement, or moving plumbing and electrical systems. In Pasadena and Glendale, older homes often create hidden costs because opening walls can reveal outdated wiring, poor drainage, termite damage, or framing issues. Homeowners should compare projects using a full scope sheet, not just a square-foot estimate. The right question is not only which costs less, but which delivers the target layout, finish level, and long-term value with fewer surprises. A builder should provide allowances, contingency ranges, and a clear list of exclusions before design is approved.
acceptedAnswer.description: A full custom build usually costs more overall than a major remodel because it includes demolition, site prep, full structural construction, and all-new systems. A major remodel can still become expensive quickly if it adds square footage, relocates utilities, or requires seismic, foundation, or hillside work.
